senses.gloss: उलुप [ulupa], = उलप q. v.
उलूप [ulūpa] पिन् [pin], पिन् See उलप, उलुपिन्.
उलुपिन् [ulupin], m. A guinea pig, porpoise; so उल (-लू)- पिन्.
ऊलुपिन् [ūlupin], A porpoise; see उलुपिन्.
उलुलिः [ululiḥ], Ved. Howling, a howl; an outcry indicative of prosperity; पृथग् घोषा उलुलयः केतुमन्त उदीरताम् Av.3.19.6.

उलूकः [ulūkḥ], 1 An owl; नोलूकोप्यवलोकते यदि दिवा सूर्यस्य किं दूषणम् Bh.2.93; त्यजति मुदमुलूकः प्रीतिमांश्चक्रवाकः Śi.11.64. cf. also कथमुलूकशब्द उलूकवचनः । रल्योः समान- वृत्तित्वात् । ŚB. on MS.9.4.22.
N. of Indra.
N. of a Muni (perhaps identical with कणाद, whose वैशेषिक- दर्शन is called आलूक्य-दर्शन).
(pl.) N. of a country and its king who was an ally of the Kurus.
कम् N. of the reed Saccharum Cylindricum; see उलप.
Fat; वनिष्टुसन्निधानादुरूकेण वपाभिधानम् । (v. l.) MS.9.4.22. -जित् A crow. -यातुः A demon in the shape of an owl; उलूकयातुं शुशुलूकयातुम् Rv.7.14.22.
उलूखलः [ulūkhalḥ], A staff of Udumbara wood. -लम् A wooden mortar used for cleansing rice (from the husk &c.); Rv.1.28.6. अवहननायोलूखलम् Mbh.; वनस्पतिभ्य इत्येवं मुषलोलूखले हरेत् Ms.3.88,5.117.
A kind of weapon; Mb.7.178.23. -Comp. -सुतः the Soma juice pressed out in a (wooden) mortar; Rv.1.28.1-4.
उलूखलकम् [ulūkhalakam], 1 A mortar; Rv.1.28.5.
Bdellium, a gummy substance or the plant which yields it. (Mar. गुग्गुळ).
उलूखलिक [ulūkhalika], a.
Pounded in a mortar.
(At the end of comp.) Using as a mortar; दन्त˚ using the teeth as a mortar; Ms.6.17; Y.3.49.
उलूतः [ulūtḥ], A large snake, the Boa (अजगर).

उलूपी [ulūpī], A Nāga princess. [She was the daughter of the serpent Kauravya. While one day she was bathing in the Ganges, she happened to see Arjuna, and being enamoured of his handsome form, she managed to have him conveyed to her home, the Pātāla, and there induced him to take her as his wife, which he, after considerable hesitation, consented to do. She bore him a son named Irāvat. When Arjuna's head was cut off by Babhruvāhana's arrow, it was with her assistance that he was restored to life; see Arjuna.]
उलूलि [ulūli] उलूलु [ulūlu], उलूलु a. Crying aloud, noisy (while joyous); तं जायमानं घोषा उलूलवो$नूदतिष्ठन् Ch. Up.3.19.3; Lāṭyāyana 4.2.9.
उलूलुध्वनिः [ulūludhvaniḥ], The noise of melodious chorus, especially of women, on happy occasions like the marriage festival; cf. उच्चैरुलूलुध्वनिमुच्चचार N. See उलुलिः.
उल्लु [ullu], a. Cutting up.
उल्लुञ्चनम् [ulluñcanam], 1 Plucking out, cutting; पादकेशाशुककरो- ल्लुञ्चनेषु पणान् दश (दमः); Y.2.217.
Plucking or pulling out the hair.
उल्लुण्ठनम् [ulluṇṭhanam] उल्लुण्ठा [ulluṇṭhā], उल्लुण्ठा 1 Rolling, wallowing.
Irony; धीराधीरा तु सोल्लुण्ठभाषणैः खेदयेदमुम् S. D.15; सोल्लुण्ठम् ironically, often occurring as a stage-direction in plays.
उल्लुण्ठित [ulluṇṭhita], a. Rubbed against.
ऊलूक [ūlūka], = उलूक q. v.
